When and where you usually wear it

phrases.phrase: be comfortable in my own skin

model: The item of clothing I wear most often is a dark blue denim jacket. I bought it about three years ago from a second-hand shop in a small alley in District 3. I wasn't planning to buy anything that day; I just went in with a friend, and the jacket was hanging at the end of a rail. I tried it on, and it was a perfect fit, so I paid the shop owner about two hundred thousand dong, which was a real bargain. Since then it's become a wardrobe staple. The main reason I love it is that it goes with everything. I can wear it over a T-shirt at the weekend, or over a shirt and trousers for a casual day at the office, so I can easily dress it up or down. It's also very hard-wearing. I've washed it hundreds of times, and apart from the colour, which has faded a little on the sleeves, it still looks almost the same. I even took it on a trip to Sa Pa last winter, and it kept me warm on the cold evenings. I think clothes can change how you feel, and whenever I put this jacket on, I feel more comfortable in my own skin. Honestly, I can't imagine getting rid of it, even when it's completely worn out.
